Definition: to suck, by implication, to relish, or (intransitively) be sweet
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be or become sweet or pleasing; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be or become sweet; 1a2) to be or become pleasant; 1a3) to suck; 1b) (Hiphil) to give sweet taste
